json.justification: The photos show a gas meter/regulator assembly mounted directly on the brick wall (Photo 14) very close to a driveway/concrete-and-gravel path with cars parked right next to the wall (Photos 9-11, 14), and a window AC unit and multiple windows interrupting the wall run (Photos 4, 15, 16). These indicate likely violations of the 5ft clearance from gas meter/drivable surface and wall obstructions, and the site context is too ambiguous to confirm a clear 15ft continuous wall path for wiring.
